dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: 今高校に行けてないんです
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to go to high school lately.

dialogue.content: いぢめられてて
dialogue.English: It's because I'm being bullied.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それはお辛いですね…
dialogue.English: That must be really tough...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ついこの前まで仲良かった友達だったのに
dialogue.English: And we were such good friends until just recently...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね、それは裏切られた気持ちになりますね
dialogue.English: I understand. That must feel like a betrayal.

dialogue.content: 急に人が変わったようにいぢめてくるようになりました。
dialogue.English: They suddenly started bullying me, as if they were completely different people.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんなことがあったんですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things happened?

dialogue.content: 受験関係で
dialogue.English: It's related to entrance exams.

dialogue.content: 私はもう進路が決まっているんです
dialogue.English: My future plans are already set.

dialogue.content: でも周りはまだ決まっていなくて
dialogue.English: But the people around me haven't decided on theirs yet.

dialogue.content: そこからギスギスし始めたような気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like that's when things started getting tense.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それは複雑な気持ちですね…
dialogue.English: That must be a complicated feeling...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 特別、進路決定していることを自慢した記憶もないのですが…
dialogue.English: I don't remember bragging about my future plans being set or anything...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 友達の態度が変わったと思うようになったのは、いつ頃からですか？
dialogue.English: When did you start noticing a change in your friends' attitudes?

dialogue.content: １ヶ月ほど前です
dialogue.English: About a month ago.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 最初は私のロッカーに鍵をかけられました
dialogue.English: At first, they put a lock on my locker.

dialogue.content: えぇ…
dialogue.English: Oh...

dialogue.content: 荷物が取り出せなくなりました
dialogue.English: I couldn't get my things out.

dialogue.content: それは困りますね…
dialogue.English: That must have been so difficult...

dialogue.content: 自分の使ってる鍵と同じものだったので
dialogue.English: It was the same kind of lock as the one I use.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 最初は「番号忘れたのかな？」と思ったのですが
dialogue.English: At first, I thought, "Did I forget the combination?"

dialogue.content: えぇ、
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 同じ形だけど別物でした
dialogue.English: It was the same shape, but it was a different lock.

dialogue.content: 鍵が違っていたということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean it was a different lock?

dialogue.content: なので番号が違く開かなくなりました
dialogue.English: Right, the combination was different, so it wouldn't open.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは…
dialogue.English: That's...

dialogue.content: 100均の安物だったので、類似品を用意するのは簡単だと思います
dialogue.English: It was a cheap one from a 100-yen shop, so I think it would've been easy to get a similar one.

dialogue.content: そんな…
dialogue.English: Oh no...

dialogue.content: まさかそんなことされるとはと驚きましたよね。。
dialogue.English: You must have been shocked that they would do something like that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その後ご相談者さんはどうされたのですか？
dialogue.English: What did you do after that?

dialogue.content: 基本的に授業は寝て過ごしてるので
dialogue.English: I basically sleep through my classes, so...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 正直ロッカーの中身はいんまりいりませんでした
dialogue.English: Honestly, I didn't really need what was in my locker.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 数日後にはスリッパを隠されました
dialogue.English: A few days later, my slippers were hidden.

dialogue.content: 上履きのようなものです
dialogue.English: They're like indoor shoes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 身の回りのことを…困りますね。
dialogue.English: Messing with your personal belongings... that's distressing.

dialogue.content: どうして友達だと分かったのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you know it was your friends?

dialogue.content: 元の私のロッカーの鍵の番号を知っているのが友達しかいないはずなので
dialogue.English: Because my friends should be the only ones who know the combination for my original lock.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね…
dialogue.English: That makes sense...

dialogue.content: 中身の教科書を貸したのは友達だけなので
dialogue.English: Also, I had only lent the textbooks that were inside to my friends.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: スリッパはその後どうされたのですか？
dialogue.English: What happened with the slippers afterward?

dialogue.content: そのロッカーの中にありました
dialogue.English: They were inside that locker.

dialogue.content: ロッカーは小さな窓が着いてるので
dialogue.English: The locker has a small window on it.

dialogue.content: 中覗いたらありました
dialogue.English: When I looked inside, they were there.

dialogue.content: えぇ、
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.content: その後、お友達には何と声かけたんですか？
dialogue.English: After that, what did you say to your friends?

dialogue.content: 避けられている気がして
dialogue.English: I felt like they were avoiding me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 話しかけても
dialogue.English: Even when I tried to talk to them,

dialogue.content: 無視というか
dialogue.English: they would kind of ignore me,

dialogue.content: 適当というか
dialogue.English: or they were dismissive.

dialogue.content: それは悲しい…
dialogue.English: That's so sad...

dialogue.content: 明らかに周りの雰囲気が変わりました
dialogue.English: The whole atmosphere around me clearly changed.

dialogue.content: 一か月前と後ではどのようにかわったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How has it changed compared to a month ago?

dialogue.content: 体育でペアを組む時に
dialogue.English: When we pair up in P.E. class,

dialogue.content: 必ず私と組んでくれてた方も組んでくれなくなりました
dialogue.English: the person who always used to pair up with me stopped.

dialogue.content: 孤独を感じてしまいますね…
dialogue.English: That must make you feel lonely...

dialogue.content: 明らかに避けられました。
dialogue.English: I was clearly being avoided.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: だからもう今は学校行ってません
dialogue.English: That's why I'm not going to school anymore.

dialogue.content: つらすぎて
dialogue.English: It's too painful.

dialogue.content: そう思うのも無理ないです…
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you feel that way...

dialogue.content: 学校の先生には心療内科に通ってるといい学校をサボっています。
dialogue.English: I've been skipping school by telling my teachers that I'm going to a psychosomatic clinic.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: そんな状況だったら、行きたくなくなりますよね
dialogue.English: In a situation like that, it's natural you wouldn't want to go.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今はゲームセンターで知り合った女性の家に匿ってもらっています。
dialogue.English: Right now, a woman I met at an arcade is letting me stay at her house.

dialogue.content: 仲良しだったのにとのことでしたが、何人くらいの方が前とは違和感を感じるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you were close friends, but about how many people are acting differently than before?

dialogue.content: 全員ですね
dialogue.English: All of them.

dialogue.content: かぶっちゃいましたね、ごめんなさい
dialogue.English: Oh, our messages overlapped, sorry.

dialogue.content: 人数だと10人ほど
dialogue.English: In terms of numbers, about 10 people.

dialogue.content: こちらこそすみません。
dialogue.English: No, I'm sorry too.

dialogue.content: クラスの子ですか？
dialogue.English: Are they classmates?

dialogue.content: クラスの人もですし同じ部活だった人もです
dialogue.English: Classmates, and also people who were in the same club.

dialogue.content: 合わせて10人ほどですね
dialogue.English: Altogether, about ten people.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 学校は居づらくてしかたないです
dialogue.English: It's just so uncomfortable being at school.

dialogue.content: 出席しなくても必要な単位等は足りてるので、もう行かなくてもいいかなと思ってます。
dialogue.English: I have enough credits even without attending, so I'm thinking maybe I don't need to go anymore.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 何が原因でそうなったのか
dialogue.English: I want to know what caused it,

dialogue.content: 聞きたくてもきけないし
dialogue.English: but I can't bring myself to ask.

dialogue.content: お考えになるのも無理ないです
dialogue.English: It's natural to wonder about that.

dialogue.content: 前のように仲良くしたいとも今は思いません
dialogue.English: I don't even want to be friends with them like before anymore.

dialogue.content: 聞くに聞けないですよね。。
dialogue.English: It's hard to ask, isn't it...

dialogue.content: 受験のイライラが溜まって、その矛先が私にたまたま向いてしまったのかも知れません。
dialogue.English: Maybe their frustration from the exams built up, and I just happened to become the target.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、
dialogue.English: I can see that.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: なので友達を恨むつもりもないです。
dialogue.English: So I don't intend to resent my friends.

dialogue.content: 受験はストレス溜まるものですし。
dialogue.English: Exams are stressful, after all.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私は早く決まって気楽ですが、逆の立場だったら
dialogue.English: I'm relieved mine was decided early, but if I were in their position,

dialogue.content: いぢめる側だったかも知れませんし
dialogue.English: I might have been the one doing the bullying.

dialogue.content: そんな風にお感じなんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 進路の状況は皆さんどんなかんじなのですか？
dialogue.English: How are things going with everyone else's plans?

dialogue.content: まだ勉強中です。
dialogue.English: They're still studying.

dialogue.content: 推薦等で決まってる人はまだいないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think anyone's path has been decided yet through recommendations or anything.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 喜びたいのに喜べない、複雑な気持ちですね
dialogue.English: You want to be happy, but you can't. It's such a complicated feeling.

dialogue.content: そうなのです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 決まったけど、自慢げに言ったら嫌われると思ったので
dialogue.English: My path was decided, but I thought if I said it boastfully, they would dislike me,

dialogue.content: えぇ、
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 周りには言わないようにしてました
dialogue.English: so I tried not to tell anyone.

dialogue.content: それがバレてから周りの態度が変わった気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like everyone's attitude changed after that got out.

dialogue.content: 本当は、一緒に喜びたいですよね…
dialogue.English: Deep down, you'd like to celebrate together, wouldn't you...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 周りには私が隠してたと思われたのでしょうか
dialogue.English: I wonder if everyone thought I was hiding it from them.

dialogue.content: むしろ私が皆を裏切ったのかもしれません
dialogue.English: Maybe I was the one who betrayed everyone.

dialogue.content: そうお感じなんですね…
dialogue.English: That's how you feel...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんな風にみんなにわかったんですか？
dialogue.English: How did everyone find out?

dialogue.content: 「お前この前試験行ったんだよな？どうだったん？」と友達に聞かれて、その時素直に答えました。
dialogue.English: A friend asked me, "You went to take an exam the other day, right? How did it go?" and I answered honestly.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どんな風に答えたんですか？
dialogue.English: How did you answer?

dialogue.content: 「みんな一生懸命勉強してる中だから言い出しにくくて」と
dialogue.English: I said, "It was hard to bring it up since everyone is studying so hard."

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 「そっか。おめでと」と返されて
dialogue.English: They replied, "I see. Congrats,"

dialogue.content: その時点で少し冷たさを感じました
dialogue.English: and at that moment, I felt a bit of coldness from them.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それから周りの雰囲気が変わった気がします。
dialogue.English: I feel like the atmosphere changed after that.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それは辛いですね。。
dialogue.English: That must be painful...

dialogue.content: 家にいても「さっさと合格せずにもっと頑張ればもっといいとこ行けたのに」親に言われます
dialogue.English: Even at home, my parents tell me, "If you had worked harder instead of passing so quickly, you could have gotten into a better school."

dialogue.content: 家にも居場所がありません
dialogue.English: I don't have a place at home either.

dialogue.content: 家にも学校にも居られません
dialogue.English: I can't be at home or at school.

dialogue.content: なので知り合った女性の家に匿ってもらっています
dialogue.English: That's why I'm staying at the house of a woman I met.

dialogue.content: 居場所がないようにお感じなんですね…
dialogue.English: So you feel like you have no place to belong...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その女性は私の味方をしてくれるので
dialogue.English: Because that woman is on my side,

dialogue.content: えぇ、
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ゲームセンターの方
dialogue.English: The woman from the arcade,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でしょうか？
dialogue.English: is that right?

dialogue.content: 昼間にゲームセンターで遊んでたら声かけられて
dialogue.English: I was playing at the arcade during the day, and she started talking to me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 「学校サボっちゃだめだぞ」と
dialogue.English: and she said, "You shouldn't be skipping school."

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: そこから色々話して仲良くなり
dialogue.English: From there, we talked about various things and became friends,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 可能な限りその人の家に入れてもらってます
dialogue.English: and I've been staying at her house as much as possible.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: そこがいま私の唯一の避難場所です。
dialogue.English: That place is my only refuge right now.

dialogue.content: その方はどんな方なんですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of person is she?

dialogue.content: 優しい方です
dialogue.English: She's a kind person.

dialogue.content: でも寂しがり屋で
dialogue.English: But she gets lonely easily.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 旦那さんが単身赴任でほとんど家にいないから、遊び相手が欲しかったと
dialogue.English: Her husband is away on a work assignment and is almost never home, so she said she wanted someone to hang out with.

dialogue.content: お互い寂しいからちょうど良かったねって
dialogue.English: She said it worked out well because we're both lonely.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 居心地のいい場所なんですね。
dialogue.English: So it's a comfortable place for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 旦那さんが家に帰ってくる日以外はお邪魔してます
dialogue.English: I visit on the days her husband isn't home.

dialogue.content: そのダメな日は私は自宅で引きこもってます。
dialogue.English: On the days I can't, I just shut myself in at home.

dialogue.content: その方にご相談はされたんですか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to her about your situation?

dialogue.content: 全部話しました
dialogue.English: I told her everything.

dialogue.content: 試験のこともですか？
dialogue.English: About the exam, too?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それはほっとしますね
dialogue.English: That must be a relief.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 全て受け入れてくれました
dialogue.English: She accepted everything about me.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 家にも居づらいこと
dialogue.English: That it's uncomfortable at home,

dialogue.content: 居場所を見つけられたんですね
dialogue.English: You've found a place where you belong.

dialogue.content: 友達がひどいことする
dialogue.English: that my friends are doing terrible things,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 「あなたが悪いわけじゃない」って言ってくれました
dialogue.English: She told me, "It's not your fault."

dialogue.content: そういう敵とは関わらなければいいと
dialogue.English: And that I shouldn't get involved with people who treat me like an enemy.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 逃げるのも悪いことじゃないと
dialogue.English: And that running away isn't a bad thing either.

dialogue.content: それを聞いてどう思われましたか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when you heard that?

dialogue.content: とても気持ちが楽になりました
dialogue.English: I felt so much more at ease.

dialogue.content: ただたまに冷静になる時もあります。
dialogue.English: But sometimes I think about it calmly.

dialogue.content: 私がやっていることって良くないことですよね。
dialogue.English: What I'm doing isn't right, is it?

dialogue.content: そう思われるんですね。
dialogue.English: That's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: 学校や親の件は私が悪くないにしても
dialogue.English: Even if I'm not the one at fault regarding school and my parents,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 結婚してる女性の家に転がり込んでるって
dialogue.English: staying at a married woman's house...

dialogue.content: 世間的にはいけないことですよね？
dialogue.English: Socially, that's not an acceptable thing to do, right?

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんは学校のことでなく、その方の事でお悩みなのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Perhaps your concern isn't about school, but about this woman.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません。
dialogue.English: That might be it.

dialogue.content: 結局居場所がないのかなって
dialogue.English: I wonder if, in the end, I really have no place to belong.

dialogue.content: 家もダメ、学校もダメ
dialogue.English: Home is no good, school is no good.

dialogue.content: えぇ、
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: その女性のところは居心地いいけれども
dialogue.English: Her place is comfortable, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ほんとはいてはいけない場所なのではないかと
dialogue.English: I wonder if it's a place I'm not really supposed to be.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 冷静になると孤独を感じますね…
dialogue.English: When you think about it calmly, you feel lonely, don't you...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その女性は
dialogue.English: That woman...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 「寂しがりな生き物が一緒にいるだけじゃない。お互いに助け合ってるんだから、なんも悪くないでしょ」って
dialogue.English: She says, "It's just two lonely creatures living together. We're helping each other out, so there's nothing wrong with it, right?"

dialogue.content: そう言われたのですね…
dialogue.English: That's what she told you...

dialogue.content: その人は私の何でも受け入れてくれるし、すごく居心地がいいんです
dialogue.English: She accepts everything about me, and it's so comfortable there.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 身体の関係も持ってしまいました。
dialogue.English: We've also become physically intimate.

dialogue.content: 今までのお話をまとめさせてもらってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、もどかしいですね…
dialogue.English: I see, that must be frustrating...

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんは受験に受かってから、友達の態度が冷たくなったと感じてらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: You feel that after you passed your exam, your friends' attitudes turned cold.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仲良しの人が人が変わったようにロッカーに鍵をかけたりスリッパを隠したり
dialogue.English: People you were close with started acting like different people—locking your locker and hiding your slippers.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 避けられているように感じ、孤独を感じていました。
dialogue.English: You felt like you were being avoided and felt lonely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな時ゲームセンターで出会った女性が沢山お話を聞いてくれて、
dialogue.English: At that time, a woman you met at an arcade listened to everything you had to say,

dialogue.content: 旦那さんがいないときは、その方のおうちに行くようになりました。
dialogue.English: and you started going to her house when her husband wasn't there.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 試験受かったのに、喜びたいのに喜べない。友達もご家族も気持ちに共感してくれない中孤独を感じていて、その方がご相談者さんの居場所に感じ
dialogue.English: Even though you passed your exam, you want to be happy but can't. You feel lonely because neither your friends nor your family empathize with you, and you feel that this woman's home is your place to belong.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その方といる時は、孤独も安らぐ状況だと思いましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It seems that when you are with her, your loneliness subsides. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: 大体その通りです
dialogue.English: That's mostly correct.

dialogue.content: でもその女性との関係は良くない事だと冷静になると考えてしまいます
dialogue.English: But when I think about it calmly, I realize my relationship with her isn't right.

dialogue.content: しかしその方には旦那さんがいるので、複雑なお気持ちをもたれています。
dialogue.English: However, because she has a husband, you have complicated feelings about the situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: かぶりました…
dialogue.English: Our messages overlapped...

dialogue.content: すみません
dialogue.English: Sorry.

dialogue.content: いえ、すみません
dialogue.English: No, I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 複雑でお辛い気持ちですね…
dialogue.English: Such complex and painful feelings...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 居場所だと思っているけど、どこかにダメだとストップをかける自分もいる
dialogue.English: You feel it's your place to belong, but there's also a part of you telling yourself to stop, that it's wrong.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 身体の関係をもって更におなやみになったのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: I imagine becoming physically intimate has troubled you even more, hasn't it?

dialogue.content: いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Is that the case?

dialogue.content: 悩んだというか
dialogue.English: It's not that I'm troubled...

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 余計に離れがたくなったという感じになりました
dialogue.English: it's more like it has become even harder to leave her.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 身も心も奪われたと言いますか
dialogue.English: It's like she's taken both my body and soul.

dialogue.content: 更に大切になったのですね
dialogue.English: So she's become even more important to you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その人に依存してしまいました
dialogue.English: I've become dependent on her.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 唯一の居場所を失いたくないと思い始めました
dialogue.English: I've started to feel that I don't want to lose my only place to belong.

dialogue.content: それは心が葛藤しますよね
dialogue.English: That must create a lot of inner conflict.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 今はするつもりないですけど、
dialogue.English: I don't intend to do it now, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: そのうち
dialogue.English: eventually,

dialogue.content: 自分の居場所がほしくて
dialogue.English: because I want a place to belong,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 親か友達かその人の旦那か邪魔な存在を消そうとする自分が生まれそうで怖いです。
dialogue.English: I'm scared a part of me might emerge that tries to eliminate anyone who gets in the way—my parents, my friends, or her husband.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それは絶対やっちゃダメだと思ってはいます
dialogue.English: I know I absolutely shouldn't do that,

dialogue.content: でも居場所がほしくて
dialogue.English: but I just want a place to belong so badly.

dialogue.content: それは心が葛藤で引き裂かれそうですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like your heart is being torn apart by this conflict.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 居場所、欲しいですよね
dialogue.English: You want a place to belong, don't you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話を伺って私が思ったことをお伝えしてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I share my thoughts on what I've heard so far?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんは、お友達に冷たい態度をとられながらも
dialogue.English: Even though your friends have been treating you coldly,

dialogue.content: 私が友達の立場だったらと、考えられるお優しい方だと思いました。
dialogue.English: I think you are a very kind person for being able to consider things from their perspective, thinking, 'If I were in their shoes.'

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: その一方で
dialogue.English: On the other hand,

dialogue.content: 学校にも家族にも居場所がないように感じられ、
dialogue.English: you feel you don't have a place at school or with your family,

dialogue.content: お優しさと人を思う思いやりから、我慢して自分の辛いお気持ちを押し込めてきたようにも思います
dialogue.English: and I think that because of your kindness and consideration for others, you've been enduring and suppressing your own painful feelings.

dialogue.content: ( ﾟｰﾟ)ｳ ( ｡_｡)ﾝ
dialogue.English: (Nods in agreement)

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that resonate with you?

dialogue.content: 人のこと思って我慢してるという節はあると思います
dialogue.English: I do think there's a part of me that endures things out of consideration for others.

dialogue.content: そうでよね
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: やっと自分のありのままを出せた方があらわれた。
dialogue.English: Then, someone finally appeared with whom you could be your true self.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しかし、その方はご家族があった。誠実でお優しいあなたは相手のご家族のお気持ちも考えつつも
dialogue.English: However, that person has a family. And because you are sincere and kind, you consider her family's feelings,

dialogue.content: 自分の孤独を埋めることとの気持ちのバランスで葛藤しているように思いましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: but you also seem to be struggling to balance that with the need to ease your own loneliness. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: その通りだと思います
dialogue.English: I think that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: 他人と自分誰を守りたいのか分からなくなってます。
dialogue.English: I don't know anymore whether I want to protect others or myself.

dialogue.content: お優しく誠実なお人柄からの葛藤だと思いました
dialogue.English: I believe this conflict stems from your kind and sincere personality.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: ここはご提案なのですが
dialogue.English: This is just a suggestion, but

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたが今の状況からぬけだせるように考えたいのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I would like us to think together about how you can get out of this current situation. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 抜け出したいです
dialogue.English: I want to get out of this.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 何とか安心出来るポジションを確立させたいです。
dialogue.English: Somehow, I want to establish a position where I can feel secure.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, of course.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さん、趣味など好きなことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any hobbies or things you like to do?

dialogue.content: 趣味ですか
dialogue.English: Hobbies?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ひとつはゲームセンターのゲームですね。
dialogue.English: Well, arcade games for one.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それでその女性と知り合ったのですが
dialogue.English: That's how I met that woman.

dialogue.content: あとはなんだろう…
dialogue.English: What else...

dialogue.content: たとえばですが
dialogue.English: For example,

dialogue.content: 結構無趣味なんです…
dialogue.English: I don't really have many hobbies...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今、孤独をいやすために「居場所」を探している状態だと思いますが
dialogue.English: I think right now you're searching for a "place to belong" to heal your loneliness,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 好きなご飯を食べたり
dialogue.English: like eating your favorite food,

dialogue.content: 一人で旅に行ったり
dialogue.English: going on a trip by yourself,

dialogue.content: 全然違う人と出会ってみたり
dialogue.English: or meeting completely different people.

dialogue.content: 学生なのであまりお金がなくて…
dialogue.English: I'm a student, so I don't have much money...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでしたら
dialogue.English: In that case,

dialogue.content: 学校からは禁止されてるんですが
dialogue.English: it's prohibited by my school, but

dialogue.content: アルバイトは考えてます
dialogue.English: I'm thinking about getting a part-time job.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: してみたいなって
dialogue.English: I'd like to try it.

dialogue.content: いいですね、アルバイト！
dialogue.English: A part-time job, that's a great idea!

dialogue.content: お金もかせげるし
dialogue.English: I can earn money, too,

dialogue.content: 今複雑なお気持ちなので
dialogue.English: Since your feelings are so complicated right now,

dialogue.content: 見つかったら問題になりそうなので、バレなそうなのを探す予定です
dialogue.English: and it would be a problem if I got caught, so I plan to look for one where I won't be found out.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 全然違う方に気持ちを向けてみるのも一つの方法かなと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I think turning your attention toward something completely different could be one way to handle this.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お優しく誠実で
dialogue.English: You are a kind and sincere person,

dialogue.content: 人のことが考えられる方だから
dialogue.English: and you're considerate of others,

dialogue.content: きっとバイトでも頼られる存在になるのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: so I'm sure you would become a reliable and valued person at a part-time job, don't you think?

dialogue.content: そうですかね
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: そうだといいです
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: その方への気持ちは
dialogue.English: As for your feelings for her,

dialogue.content: すぐに消すのはお辛いと思うので
dialogue.English: I know it would be painful to try and erase them right away,

dialogue.content: (ﾟｰﾟ)(｡_｡)ｳﾝｳﾝ
dialogue.English: (Nods)

dialogue.content: 少しずつ少しずつ
dialogue.English: so little by little,

dialogue.content: ご自分を責めない程度に
dialogue.English: to an extent that you don't blame yourself,

dialogue.content: バランスをとっていくといいかなと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I think it would be good to work on finding a balance. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I agree.

dialogue.content: アルバイトはじめて気を紛らわしたり、新しい友達とか作ればそこが新しい居場所にもなりそうです
dialogue.English: If I start a part-time job, I can distract myself, and if I make new friends, that could become a new place for me to belong.

dialogue.content: はい！そう思いますよ！
dialogue.English: Yes! I think so too!

dialogue.content: いいアルバイト先が見つかるといいですね。
dialogue.English: I hope you find a good part-time job.

dialogue.content: 新しい「居場所」作り、心から応援しております！
dialogue.English: I'll be wholeheartedly rooting for you as you create a new "place to belong"!

dialogue.content: はい^^*
dialogue.English: Yes. ^^*

dialogue.content: きっとお優しい方だから、わかってくれる方はあらわれますよ！
dialogue.English: You're such a kind person, I'm sure someone who understands you will appear!

dialogue.content: 応援しています！
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for you!

dialogue.content: そうだといいです^^
dialogue.English: I hope so. ^^

dialogue.content: がんばります
dialogue.English: I'll do my best.

dialogue.content: (あぁ…すごいすぎちゃいました…)
dialogue.English: (Ah... I went way over time...)

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: (語りすぎちゃいました)
dialogue.English: (I talked too much.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます！遅くまでごめんなさい…💦)
dialogue.English: (Thank you! I'm sorry for keeping you so late... 💦)

dialogue.content: (評価シートなのですが、明日の夜書き上げるのでもよろしいでしょうか)
dialogue.English: (Regarding the evaluation sheet, would it be alright if I finish writing it tomorrow night?)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそ遅くまでありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well for staying up so late.)

dialogue.content: (全然大丈夫です！ありがとうございます！)
dialogue.English: (That's totally fine! Thank you!)

dialogue.content: (助かります^^)
dialogue.English: (That's a big help. ^^)

dialogue.content: (大変勉強になりました。ありがとうございますm(__)m)
dialogue.English: (This has been a great learning experience. Thank you very much. m(__)m)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそありがとうございましたm(*_ _)m)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. m(*_ _)m)

dialogue.content: (それでは、終了いたします。)
dialogue.English: (Alright then, we'll end the session here.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそです、おやすみなさいm(__)m)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. Good night. m(__)m)

dialogue.content: (おやすみなさいませ)
dialogue.English: (Good night.)
